components.name: InputCalculator
components.description: Headless formula field: type `=price * qty * (1 + tax)` and get the value, like a spreadsheet cell. It renders no styles. Compose InputCalculatorInput, InputCalculatorResult and InputCalculatorHighlight inside it, or pass a function child to render from the state yourself.

props.name: value
props.description: The formula text. Pass it to control the field.

props.name: variables
props.description: Names the formula can use, e.g. `{ price: 20, total: "=price * qty" }`.

props.name: functions
props.description: Extra functions, or replacements for built-ins. Names ignore case.

props.name: requireEquals
props.description: Only evaluate text that starts with "=", like a spreadsheet cell.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns a value into display text. Defaults to 15 significant digits.

props.name: onResult
props.description: Fires whenever the result changes, as you type.

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Fires on Enter, and on blur after an edit.

props.name: resolveOnCommit
props.description: On commit, replace the formula with its value: `=6*7` becomes `42`.

props.name: locked
props.description: Stops the formula being edited: the field turns read-only and Enter, Escape and blur do nothing. The result still follows `variables`, and `value` or `setFormula` can still change the formula from code.

components.name: InputCalculatorInput
components.description: The formula field: a plain input wired to the calculator.

components.name: InputCalculatorResult
components.description: Live result, announced politely to screen readers.

props.name: children
props.description: Render the result yourself. Defaults to the value or the error code.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the formula is empty.

components.name: InputCalculatorHighlight
components.description: The formula as token spans (`data-token="number" | "name" | "function"…`), with `data-error="invalid" | "incomplete"` on the part an error points at. Lay it under a transparent input to colour the formula as it is typed.
